transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're here for the weekly access-control review before the passkey rollout scheduled for Monday at 09:00. I need to go through the checklist with each of you individually before I can approve the production rollout plan. Let's start with the identity platform lead — please state any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you'll own.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated mobile-device enrollment issue this morning, I confirmed that 23 legacy mobile clients cannot complete the passkey ceremony. The identity platform team requires a 10% canary and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not updated the rollout ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: While preparing the weekly administrator access roster, I confirmed that 18 contractor accounts do not receive their required hardware keys until Wednesday at 09:00. IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time, but I have not added the exception list to the rollout plan yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft rollout keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which does not meet this requirement. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout. The exact plan change I require is: update the audit-log retention for privileged administrator authentication events to 400 days in immutable storage before the rollout proceeds. I will own opening the compliance ticket and verifying the retention configuration is in place.
transcript.speaker: A4
